en.subtitle: Senior Backend Engineer — Go · Ruby · Python, Cloud & Distributed Systems

about.paragraph1: I build and operate backend systems: Go, Ruby, and Python services with the APIs, auth, data models, and cloud infrastructure behind them. 15+ years shipping and running production software across logistics, fintech, medical IT, and games — in Tokyo since 2004.
about.paragraph2: Recently I led Veltra's platform work — a standards-compliant OAuth 2.1 authorization server and MCP services on AWS ECS with Terraform, the activity-search connector now live in Anthropic's public Claude connector directory — and before that owned core domain verticals and the shared integration-test harness on a Go logistics SaaS. I care about correctness under concurrency, idempotency, and tests that let a team move fast without breaking production.
